candidates.change_summary: Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' to change the return value when the function completes successfully.
Remove the multiplication by 10^18, transferring only v[i] token units (likely zero or dust).
Change the operation from multiplication to division by 10^18, drastically reducing the transferred amount.
Replace the require for msg.sender with a true condition, removing the caller restriction.
Delete the first require check, allowing any caller to invoke transfer.
Replace the revert with a no-op on failure, causing the transfer call to silently fail instead of reverting the whole transaction.
